SELECT SVC_CNTR_NO , CONTRACT_NUM , CUST_ID , MODEL_NAME , MODEL_ID , CNTR_MOBILE_NO , SUB_STATUS , DOBYYYYMMDD , USER_NAME , unUserSSn , LST_COM_ACTV_DATE , CUSTOMER_ID , CUSTOMER_TYPE , PPPO , BAN_ADR_ZIP , BAN_ADR_PRIMARY_LN , BAN_ADR_SECONDARY_LN , ESIM_YN FROM ( SELECT A.SVC_CNTR_NO , A.CONTRACT_NUM , A.CUSTOMER_ID AS CUST_ID , A.MODEL_NAME , A.MODEL_ID , A.SUBSCRIBER_NO AS CNTR_MOBILE_NO , A.SUB_STATUS , A.DOBYYYYMMDD , A.SUB_LINK_NAME AS USER_NAME , A.USER_SSN AS unUserSSn , A.LST_COM_ACTV_DATE , B.CUSTOMER_ID , B.CUSTOMER_TYPE , A.PPPO , A.SUB_ADR_ZIP AS BAN_ADR_ZIP , A.SUB_ADR_PRIMARY_LN AS BAN_ADR_PRIMARY_LN , A.SUB_ADR_SECONDARY_LN AS BAN_ADR_SECONDARY_LN , CASE WHEN A.USIM_TYPE = 'E' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ESIM_YN FROM MSP_JUO_SUB_INFO A, MSP_JUO_CUS_INFO B WHERE A.CUSTOMER_ID = B.CUSTOMER_ID
AND A.SVC_CNTR_NO = #{svcCntrNo}
AND A.SUBSCRIBER_NO = TRIM(#{cntrMobileNo})
AND UPPER(REPLACE(A.SUB_LINK_NAME, ' ', '')) = UPPER(REPLACE(#{subLinkName}, ' ', ''))
AND A.SUB_STATUS <> 'C' ORDER BY A.CONTRACT_NUM DESC /* 20260625 */ ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT CMN.PRDT_ID, CMN.PRDT_NM PROD_NM, CMN.RPRS_PRDT_ID, CMN.PRDT_CODE REQ_MODEL_NM, (SELECT MAX(PROD_ID) FROM NMCP_PROD_BAS@DL_MCP WHERE RPRS_PRDT_ID = CMN.RPRS_PRDT_ID AND SALE_YN='Y') PROD_ID, CMN.PRDT_TYPE_CD, -- 제품유형코드 CMN.PRDT_IND_CD, -- 제품구분코드 CMN.PRDT_COLR_CD, -- 제품색상코드 CMN.RPRS_YN, CMN.MNFCT_ID, SALE.SALE_PLCY_CD, SALE.PRDT_ID AS S_PRDT_ID, SALE.OLD_YN, SALE.NEW_CMSN_AMT, SALE.MNP_CMSN_AMT, SALE.HCN_CMSN_AMT FROM MSP_SALE_PRDT_MST SALE INNER JOIN CMN_INTM_MDL CMN ON SALE.PRDT_ID = CMN.PRDT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND PRDT_TYPE_CD = '01' -- 제품유형코드 --AND PRDT_IND_CD = '04' -- 제품구분코드 AND OLD_YN='N' -- 중고여부 AND RPRS_YN='Y' --대표여부 --AND PRDT_DT >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') -- 제품단종일자 임시주석 AND SALE.PRDT_ID= #{modelId} AND rownum = 1
